items.claim: He is an aging fighter whose long career is starting to weigh on him.
items.quote: he's an aging fighter... you've had a long career it's starting to weigh on you

items.claim: He is a solid striker with effective leg and body kicks.
items.quote: He's a solid striker with a lot of He's got a good leg and body kicks.

items.claim: He has tight defense and is a pretty durable guy.
He has decent grappling with good top pressure once he gets on top.
items.quote: decent grappling, decent enough takedowns, but if he gets on top, he's got good top pressure.

items.claim: He has a solid jab that is one of the better ones in the division, good movement, and high output.
items.quote: Good striker, solid jab, one of the better jabs in the division. Uh good movement, puts together some basic combinations and a ton of output.

items.claim: He has only been knocked out once in his 25-fight career and is very durable.
items.quote: that's the only time he's ever been knocked out in his 25 fights... the dude is durable.

items.claim: He is a fast, solid striker with a dynamic attack, good kick arsenal, and controls the range.
items.quote: Solid striker. He's fast. Dude's quick, very dynamic attack, good kick arsenal, works the body really well, and controls the range.

items.claim: He has a kill-or-be-killed style and almost always finishes fights or gets finished in the first round.
items.quote: kill or be killed... pretty much always first round.
